piece.headline: Cherag stretches the lead as Palmer delivers
piece.standfirst: Cherag backed the right captain and the lead is now 18 points. Dominic's Free Hit went the other way.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Dinesh started the wrong 11 and left 22 points on the bench. He did it on a Free Hit. The best chip of the season, spent on a team sheet he got wrong.
piece.one_to_watch: IB and Maanav sit just 2 points apart at the Tin Pot line. One good captain pick from either could flip the order next week.

winners.name: Cherag
winners.verdict: Palmer wore the armband and delivered. The gap to Sid has trebled. Cherag now has everyone else looking up the table at him.

winners.name: Bhavik
winners.verdict: Only Bhavik picked Cunha as captain. It gave him 20 with the armband. He went against the crowd and the crowd lost.

winners.name: Nihal
winners.verdict: Palmer armband, 16 points, and a climb of 8 places. Followed the crowd and the crowd was right for once.

losers.name: Dominic
losers.verdict: The Free Hit did not help. Fernandes as captain scored 2, and the bench held 17. A rough week, but the chip is gone and the table is still tight.

losers.name: Dinesh
losers.verdict: Burned a Free Hit and watched 22 points rot on the bench. The chip was meant to fix things. It did the opposite.
